import requests import json import time import os import re from itertools import cycle
os.makedirs(“app”, exist_ok=True)
API_URL = “ KEYS = [ “csk-x4ypjh4j49ekvty65ncp5vnwntw8hpwj5ce9y5624y93cftf”, “csk-2e5ffjjhpv8rtvm9twh4k26kxphhkjrmcpxf6xrdcj5epfmk”, “csk-e3ht9f9w9w9nc9x8yf8ke6kr2krfkyxjj3hcvvdympd9246j” ] MODELS = [“gpt-oss-120b”, “qwen-3-32b”, “qwen-3-coder-480b”] SLEEP_TIMES = { “gpt-oss-120b”: 2.0, “qwen-3-32b”: 2.0, “qwen-3-coder-480b”: 6.0 } key_cycle = cycle(KEYS) model_cycle = cycle(MODELS)
LANGUAGES = [ {“code”: “hu”, “name”: “Hungarian”}, {“code”: “tr”, “name”: “Turkish”}, {“code”: “fi”, “name”: “Finnish”}, {“code”: “et”, “name”: “Estonian”}, {“code”: “ta”, “name”: “Tamil”}, {“code”: “kn”, “name”: “Kannada”}, {“code”: “te”, “name”: “Telugu”}, {“code”: “ko”, “name”: “Korean”}, {“code”: “ja”, “name”: “Japanese”}, {“code”: “zu”, “name”: “Zulu”}, {“code”: “sw”, “name”: “Swahili”}, {“code”: “iu”, “name”: “Inuktitut”}, {“code”: “esu”, “name”: “St. Lawrence Island Yupik”}, {“code”: “yup”, “name”: “Yupik”}, {“code”: “moh”, “name”: “Mohawk”}, {“code”: “nah”, “name”: “Nahuatl”}, {“code”: “ru”, “name”: “Russian”}, {“code”: “is”, “name”: “Icelandic”}, {“code”: “sl”, “name”: “Slovenian”}, {“code”: “ar”, “name”: “Arabic”}, {“code”: “fa”, “name”: “Persian”}, {“code”: “ur”, “name”: “Urdu”}, {“code”: “el”, “name”: “Greek”}, {“code”: “vi”, “name”: “Vietnamese”}, {“code”: “zh”, “name”: “Mandarin Chinese”}, {“code”: “en”, “name”: “English”}, {“code”: “es”, “name”: “Spanish”}, {“code”: “pt”, “name”: “Portuguese”}, {“code”: “hi”, “name”: “Hindi”}, {“code”: “bn”, “name”: “Bengali”}, {“code”: “id”, “name”: “Indonesian/Malay”}, {“code”: “uby”, “name”: “Ubykh”}, {“code”: “ka”, “name”: “Georgian”}, {“code”: “sw_zu”, “name”: “Swahili/Zulu (Bantu classes)”} ]
LANGUAGE_BATCHES = [ LANGUAGES[:12], LANGUAGES[12:24], LANGUAGES[24:] ]
def extract_json(text): text = re.sub(r’json\s*', '', text) text = re.sub(r'\s*$’, ‘’, text) text = text.strip() try: start_idx = text.index(’{’) except ValueError: return None brace_count = 0 last_valid = start_idx for i, char in enumerate(text[start_idx:], start_idx): if char == ‘{’: brace_count += 1 elif char == ‘}’: brace_count -= 1 if brace_count == 0: json_str = text[start_idx:i+1] try: json.loads(json_str) return json_str except json.JSONDecodeError: pass elif brace_count < 0: break if brace_count > 0: last_valid = i + 1 if brace_count > 0: json_str = text[start_idx:last_valid] + ‘}’ * brace_count return json_str return None
def translate_batch(question, answer, batch, retries=0): if retries > 5: print(f”Max retries exceeded for batch. Returning empty.”) return {lang[‘code’]: {“question”: “”, “answer”: “”} for lang in batch} key = next(key_cycle) model = next(model_cycle) sleep_time = SLEEP_TIMES[model]
lang_str_batch = ", ".join([f"{lang['name']} ({lang['code']})" for lang in batch])
code_str_batch = ", ".join([lang['code'] for lang in batch])

system_prompt = """You are an expert multilingual translator specializing in accurate, context-preserving translations for technical and factual content. Ensure translations are natural and precise, especially for Hungarian as the primary language. Output ONLY a valid JSON object, nothing else. No explanations, no markdown, just the JSON."""

user_prompt = f"""Translate the following question and answer pair to each of the languages: {lang_str_batch}.
For the ‘en’ key if present, use the original English text exactly.
Question: {question}
Answer: {answer}
Respond with a single valid JSON object where:
	•	Keys are the language codes: {code_str_batch}
	•	Each value is an object with ‘question’ and ‘answer’ fields containing the translated text in that language.””” payload = { “model”: model, “messages”: [ {“role”: “system”, “content”: system_prompt}, {“role”: “user”, “content”: user_prompt} ], “response_format”: {“type”: “json_object”}, “temperature”: 0.0, “max_tokens”: 65536, “top_p”: 0.9 } headers = { “Content-Type”: “application/json”, “Authorization”: f”Bearer {key}” } try: response = requests.post(API_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=600) response.raise_for_status() result = response.json() content = result[“choices”][0][“message”][“content”].strip() json_str = extract_json(content) if not json_str: raise ValueError(“No valid JSON object found in response”) translations = json.loads(json_str) lang_codes = [lang[‘code’] for lang in batch] missing_codes = [code for code in lang_codes if code not in translations] if missing_codes: print(f”Incomplete translations for batch, missing {missing_codes}, retrying (attempt {retries + 1}).”) time.sleep(sleep_time) return translate_batch(question, answer, batch, retries + 1) time.sleep(sleep_time) return translations except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, IndexError, ValueError) as e: print(f”Error in response processing for batch: {e}, content: {content[:200] if ‘content’ in locals() else ‘N/A’}, retrying (attempt {retries + 1}).”) time.sleep(sleep_time) return translate_batch(question, answer, batch, retries + 1) except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: print(f”Request error in batch: {e}, retrying (attempt {retries + 1}).”) time.sleep(sleep_time) return translate_batch(question, answer, batch, retries + 1) except Exception as e: print(f”Translation failed for batch with key {key}, model {model}: {e}”) time.sleep(sleep_time) return translate_batch(question, answer, batch, retries + 1)
def translate_sample(question, answer): all_translations = {} for batch in LANGUAGE_BATCHES: batch_trans = translate_batch(question, answer, batch) all_translations.update(batch_trans) if ‘en’ in all_translations: all_translations[‘en’] = {“question”: question, “answer”: answer} return all_translations
print(“Downloading DuetQA-Verified dataset…”) download_url = “ try: response = requests.get(download_url, timeout=300) response.raise_for_status() lines = response.text.strip().split(’\n’) data = [] for line in lines: if line.strip(): try: parsed = json.loads(line) if “question” in parsed and “answer” in parsed: data.append(parsed) except json.JSONDecodeError: print(f”Skipping invalid line: {line[:100]}…”) continue print(f”Downloaded {len(data)} samples.”) except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: print(f”Failed to download dataset: {e}”) exit(1)
multilingual_data = [] batch_size = 5
for i, sample in enumerate(data): question = sample[“question”] answer = sample[“answer”] try: translations = translate_sample(question, answer) except Exception as e: print(f”Failed to translate sample {i}: {e}”) translations = {lang[‘code’]: {“question”: “”, “answer”: “”} for lang in LANGUAGES} if ‘en’ in translations: translations[‘en’] = {“question”: question, “answer”: answer}
entry = {
    "id": i,
    "original": {
        "question": question,
        "answer": answer
    },
    "translations": translations
}
multilingual_data.append(entry)

print(f"Processed sample {i+1}/{len(data)}")

if (i + 1) % batch_size == 0:
    save_path = "app/multilingual_dataset.json"
    try:
        with open(save_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(multilingual_data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        print(f"Saved batch up to {i+1}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to save batch: {e}")
save_path = “app/multilingual_dataset.json” try: with open(save_path, “w”, encoding=“utf-8”) as f: json.dump(multilingual_data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) print(f”Multilingual dataset saved to {save_path} with {len(multilingual_data)} entries.”) except Exception as e: print(f”Failed to save final dataset: {e}”)
